description: Use this when you quote a DC Hub figure, or the user asks where a number comes from or how current it is. Pass subject (what is being cited, e.g. "Phoenix DCPI verdict CAUTION"), and optionally layer, as_of and source_url from an earlier result. Returns a citation line, the license for that data layer, and current health and last-update time for each data feed. Pass since (ISO date) to also list records changed since then. It does not look up new figures.

as_of.description: The as_of value from the result being cited

layer.description: Data layer of the figure, for example dcpi, grid, fiber, facilities

since.description: ISO date or time; lists changes after it, for example 2026-09-01

source_url.description: A source link from the result being cited, if any

subject.description: What is being cited, for example "Phoenix DCPI verdict CAUTION"

name: get_evidence
title: Citation and data freshness
